question: Should the interface vocabulary of scripts/dossier/schema.json gain an mcp term?
why: ROIC.ai, Earnings Feed, AlphAI, finlight and CurrencyBeacon each serve an MCP server beside the REST API, and the vocabulary has no term for it; the records use rest and name the MCP server in interface_detail. A rules session adds the term (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12).
